prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 — Summary (under 500 words)

Core vision: A “fair deal” built on five themes — a stronger, green economy; better public services; environmental recovery; an outward‑looking UK; and a revitalised democracy.

Economy and jobs
- Responsible public finances; focus tax changes on reversing bank tax cuts and a one‑off windfall tax on oil and gas.
- Repair UK–EU trade by a new comprehensive agreement; long‑term goal to rejoin the Single Market.
- Industrial strategy centred on clean energy, digital and biosciences; 3–3.5% of GDP for R&D; UK Infrastructure Bank refocused on net zero.
- Abolish business rates, replace with a Commercial Landowner Levy; expand British Business Bank; crackdown on late payments.
- New skills offer: replace apprenticeship levy with a flexible skills levy; Lifelong Skills Grants; boost apprenticeships and technical routes.
- Modernise employment rights (dependent contractor status, sick pay from day one, fair gig‑economy rules); parental leave/pay as day‑one rights.

Health and care
- Legal right to see a GP within 7 days (24 hours if urgent); recruit 8,000 GPs; 24/7 booking; expand pharmacy, dental and mental health access.
- Cancer treatment guarantee within 62 days; more radiotherapy and cancer nurses.
- Ten‑year NHS estate and diagnostics plans; invest in digital interoperability.
- Free personal care (Scotland model); Carer’s Minimum Wage (+£2/hour), Royal College of Care Workers; cross‑party deal on social care funding; stronger support for unpaid carers.

Climate, energy and environment
- Net zero by 2045; 90% of electricity from renewables by 2030; rooftop solar drive; free insulation/heat pumps for low‑income households; social energy tariff.
- Maintain bans on fracking and new coal; expand storage, grid and interconnectors; empower local/community energy.
- End sewage scandal: tougher regulator, public‑benefit water companies, targets to stop dumping at sensitive/bathing sites by 2030, sewage tax.
- Double nature by 2050; 60m trees/year; Clean Air Act; stronger environmental watchdogs.

Education and families
- Real‑terms per‑pupil increases; fix crumbling schools; tutoring guarantee for disadvantaged pupils.
- Mental health professional in every school; SEND funding reforms.
- Early years: more free hours for disadvantaged children; triple Early Years Pupil Premium.
- Reinstate university maintenance grants; Erasmus Plus return; Lifelong Skills Grants for adults.
- Extend free school meals to all children in poverty; overhauled parental leave (higher pay, extra month for partners).

Housing and communities
- Build 380,000 homes/year, including 150,000 social; 10 new garden cities; zero‑carbon new homes; brownfield first; “use‑it‑or‑lose‑it” permissions.
- Ban no‑fault evictions; three‑year default tenancies; landlord register; abolish leasehold and cap ground rents.
- End rough sleeping next Parliament; repeal Vagrancy Act.
- Stronger local government funding; local powers over second homes/short‑lets; universal gigabit broadband.

Transport
- Restore 2030 zero‑emission sales deadline; more EV chargers; cut VAT on public charging; reintroduce plug‑in grant.
- Freeze rail fares; new Railway Agency; Northern Powerhouse Rail; long‑term electrification; stronger buses with local franchising; national active travel plan.

Rights, democracy and justice
- Proportional representation (STV) for MPs and English councils; scrap voter ID; votes at 16; written federal constitution; cap party donations; reform Lords.
- Strengthen community policing; guarantee police attendance for burglaries; tackle court backlogs; public health approach to youth violence.
- Champion Human Rights Act; ban conversion practices; anti‑SLAPP law; curb facial recognition; enhanced equality and anti‑hate measures.

Immigration and asylum
- End Hostile Environment; scrap Rwanda plan and Illegal Migration Act; 3‑month target for most asylum decisions; allow work after 3 months.
- Flexible work visa system; reverse family visa threshold rise; restore rights for care/NHS staff; expand Youth Mobility; protect EU citizens’ status.

International and defence
- Rebuild relations with Europe via staged roadmap; uphold rules‑based order; restore aid to 0.7% with poverty focus.
- Support Ukraine; seize frozen Russian assets to aid Ukraine.
- Advocate immediate bilateral ceasefire in Israel–Gaza and a two‑state solution; recognise Palestine.
- Increase defence spending towards 2.5% GDP; reverse Army cuts; maintain nuclear deterrent; tighter arms export controls.
